parsed.notes:
Anforderungen sets the required default; idealerweise makes AWS, AWS Glue and Lake Formation optional.
AWS Glue and Lake Formation have no taxonomy entries; they are optional alternatives, but no mapped alternative group can be formed for them.
Fundierte Erfahrung expresses depth, not an explicit level or proven experience; seniority is therefore null.
Qualitätssicherung KI-generierter Ergebnisse is treated literally as AI-output evaluation, not as a separate software-testing requirement.
Skills appearing only under Aufgaben are excluded; soft skills, spoken languages and the degree are not skill criteria.
